source.snippet: Marketing agencies hand-write SEO meta titles and descriptions for hundreds of client pages every month — slow, repetitive, and inconsistent across writers.

problem_statement: Marketing agencies hand-write SEO meta titles and descriptions for hundreds of client pages every month — slow, repetitive, and inconsistent across writers.
target_segment: Small SEO/marketing agencies (5-50 staff) managing many client sites
notes: Clear paying buyer: agencies already pay for Surfer SEO, Clearscope ($99-199/mo). Fully AI-buildable: upload a sitemap/URL list, Claude generates optimized meta tags, delivered as a CSV. Hands-off bulk productized service. Recurring per-client-batch revenue.
